questions.question: What does photosynthesis mean, and where in the plant does it mostly happen?
questions.expected_answer: Photosynthesis means putting food together using light. Green plants make their own food, mostly in their green leaves, where chlorophyll traps energy from sunlight.

questions.question: Name the three things a plant needs to make food and say where each comes from.
questions.expected_answer: Water comes from the soil through the roots and up the stem. Carbon dioxide comes from the air through tiny holes in the leaves. Sunlight gives the energy.

questions.question: What gas do plants give off when they make food, and why is it important for animals?
questions.expected_answer: Plants give off oxygen. Animals and people need oxygen to breathe, so they depend on plants for the oxygen in the air.
